title: Your Digital Watch Box
caption: Switch between List, Grid, and full-screen Gallery views with custom sorting, or use realtime search to quickly find the watch you're looking for.

title: Wear Stats & Wrist Recap
caption:
Generate charts to analyze wear frequency, cost-per-wear or the details of your collection...
or use the WristRecap feature to see dashboards of your wear habits, monthly, annually or for a period of your choice!

title: Watch setting
caption:
Get the accurate time, synced with atomic time servers.
WristTrack Pro users can also get moon phase information and save multiple additional timezones for GMT setting.

title: Wear Calendar
caption: Visualize every wear day, warranty expiry, and service date at a glance.
